preconditions.description: The number of graph variants t must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each graph variant must have between 1 and 500,000 vertices and between 0 and 500,000 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge connections must be within the range of vertex indices.

postconditions.description: If the answer exists, the output must start with 'Yes' followed by the number of vertices stolen and their indices.

postconditions.expression: any((degree - c) % 3 == degree % 3 for degree in degrees)
postconditions.description: After stealing vertices, the degree of each remaining vertex must remain unchanged modulo 3.
The number of vertices stolen must be greater than 0 and less than the total number of vertices.
